title: Remove the waitlist, survey and contact intake once the private repo serves it
description:
The waitlist, survey and contact endpoints (GET /waitlist/survey, POST /waitlist, GET /waitlist/confirm, GET /waitlist/invite, POST /contact), with their Python modules (waitlist/*, email_sender, offer_snapshot, waitlist_limits, waitlist_scoring, waitlist_survey, http/waitlist_source, the ControlPlane waitlist methods and store items) and their 7 features (56 scenarios), serve only the marketing site. They move to the private repo AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web (boundary epic chatticus-3926bc); they are not ported to TypeScript here.

Feature: The product repo carries no marketing intake
  Scenario: The waitlist routes are gone
    Given the marketing site serves its own waitlist and contact intake
    When the product front door is asked for /waitlist/survey
    Then it answers 404

Blocked until the marketing site no longer calls these routes. Confirm the marketing site's base URL first. Then delete the code, features, steps and tests in one change.

What remains (triage 2026-10-14): The routes and the Python modules are already gone: python/ was deleted (PR 467) and conversation/src, web/ and infra/lib contain no waitlist, survey or contact route. Left: (1) the scenario 'The waitlist routes are gone' (product front door answers 404 for /waitlist/survey) does not exist in features/; (2) dead code: WaitlistRateLimitedError in conversation/src/http/errors.ts with its mapping to 429 and its test in conversation/test/route-audience.test.ts; (3) confirm the private marketing repo serves its own intake (owner confirmation, see question on the ticket). 'Waitlist-safe' in principal.ts and routes is the pending-organization concept, not marketing intake, and stays.
